name: Thing in the Ice // Awoken Horror

faces.name: Thing in the Ice
faces.text:
Defender
This creature enters with four ice counters on it.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, remove an ice counter from this creature. Then if it has no ice counters on it, transform it.

faces.name: Awoken Horror
faces.text: When this creature transforms into Awoken Horror, return all non-Horror creatures to their owners' hands.
